objective: Document chunks carry the wrong heading after a heading that arrives mid-chunk. server/services/documents/chunker.ts ~L110 `pendingHeadingPath = headingPath;` on a size-triggered flush overwrites the heading that arrived inside the chunk with the chunk's older heading. Reproduced: blocks [HEADING 'A', PARAGRAPH 1000 chars, HEADING 'B', PARAGRAPH 2500, PARAGRAPH 500] with maxChars 3000 yield a second chunk labelled ['A'] although its block sits under B, so retrieval's heading bonus and citations name the wrong section (CLAUDE.md §10). Fix: track the last HEADING block seen and on a size flush set the pending heading path from it; keep the rule that a heading only starts a new chunk once the current one has substance.
expectedOutcome: A chunk flushed for size is labelled with the most recent heading preceding its first block.
nonGoals: Changing chunk size limits or block ordering
Any schema change or re-chunking of stored documents

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/chunkerHeadingCarry.test.ts: the reproduction above yields ['B'] as the second chunk's heading path.
tests/documents.test.ts 'starts a chunk at a heading once the current one has substance' still passes.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; affects newly chunked documents only.
